answer: An agent proves solvency by publishing a Merkle proof-of-reserves: its exchange balance is committed in a public tree, like a frozen tundra of audited deposits, while liabilities are hashed as leaves any user can verify. A prism of independent auditors re-checks the root each epoch, so hidden leverage cannot survive. The willow of reputation bends but does not break: an agent that falsifies reserves loses its attested history and must rebuild trust from zero.
